release_notes: Mandatory OPS Android 4.5.24 Task photo evidence preview fix. Captured photos that later fail during processing, upload or D1 registration remain visible and tappable so staff can inspect the actual image before choosing Retry or Delete. The failure panel is confined to the bottom of the photo and no longer blocks preview taps. Native Task photo capture from 4.5.23 is retained. No D1 migration or backfill.
